nonblocking_limits.detail: Cancel is selected by a globally unique content-desc/clickable/enabled predicate without a Trime package/class predicate. The subsequent editor text can stay unchanged even if composition remained pending. Offline qualification must verify the retained after-XML contains the intended Trime control before the touch and no Current input/locked segment plus disabled/absent Cancel afterward, and must inspect the actual image.
This static review qualifies runner v5 for later controlled execution. It does not qualify b14a on API21, API35, or a physical phone, and does not reinterpret raw passed=false/checks[].
scope5 itself remains UNFROZEN_NEW_SOURCE_REQUIRED. A later producer may bind the separately audited exact-b14 artifact and runner bytes; that later binding/execution requires its own evidence.
